notes.title: TRY THE DEMO :]
notes.content:
Just a little announcement to say the [b]Night of the Living Dead DEMO[/b] is still available on main page.
It has been very helpful for curious individuals or just anybody not sure what an interactive film even is :]

I also want to thank the helpful people on the hub. I've enjoyed working through the suggestions on any titles that look viable for converting to interactive movies. I hope to continue with these asap.

Also, the COLOR batch of Interactive Films are over here:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1734470/ROUGH_KUTS_The_Thirsty_Dead/

notes.title: NEW INTERACTIVE FILM 'MONSTROSITY'
notes.content:
[u]Another mad genius scientist transplanting brains.. will he succeed or create another MONSTROSITY..!?
[/u]
PLOT: A rich but unscrupulous old woman plots with a scientist to have her brain implanted in the skull of a sexy young woman.

[b]Try to survive and outwit the nasty old woman Mrs March!
Use your brain in this one.. because she wants to remove it![/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1761610/ROUGH_KUTS_Monstrosity/

Oh, don't forget I'll be bringing some new COLOR films under the title 'THE THIRSTY DEAD' in a week or so. WISHLIST IT to be notified. Thanks for reading.
